physicalNotes: Radius 1.359 +0.016 −0.019 Jupiter radii (at 71492 km per Jupiter radius) from Torres et al. 2008 (ApJ 677, 1324 (2008); arXiv:0801.1841), at 6378.137 km per Earth radius. No gravitational parameter is adopted. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

sources.shape: Inclination 86.71 degrees and a/R* = 8.76 ± 0.04, both from Torres et al. 2008, Table 2. Eccentricity is set to 0: a circular display approximation, not an orbital solution.
sources.phase: Torres et al. 2008, Table 2, row 3 HD 209458: T0 = BJD_TDB 2459893.75120 ± 0.00005, MEASURED here from the JWST NIRCam F322W2 grism white-light curve of programme 1274 observation 2 (MAST product jw01274-o002_t002_nircam_f322w2-grismr-subgrism64_whtlt.ecsv), by a trapezoid fit with a linear baseline; the paper gives no transit time.
sources.orientation: Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north).
